##


Verifpay V3 Branch Details Enhancements


**Deployment Date: October 30, 2026**


The[VerifyPay V3 API](https://docs.decentro.tech/reference/verifypay-V3) now returns an` is_verified` boolean attribute within the` branch_details` object. This informs merchants whether the bank branch associated with the provided IFSC has been cross-verified against authoritative banking datasets.

####


Compatibility & Action Required


*Backward Compatible* : Existing integrations will continue to function without changes. Existing response keys and payload structures remain intact.


*Integration Action* : Merchants wishing to automate branch trust checks can consume the is_verified flag directly to validate payout destinations during onboarding or transaction verification.


##


Deprecation of Remitter Whitelisting and Settlement Account Management for the V3 Virtual Account Platform.


As part of our ongoing security audits and compliance requirements, the following APIs have been deprecated:


- [Settlement Account Mapping API](https://docs.decentro.tech/reference/payments_api-settlementsv3-manage-settlement)
- [Remitter Whitelisting API](https://docs.decentro.tech/reference/remitter-whitelisting-1)


To update the relevant details, please send an email to[\[email protected\]](https://docs.decentro.tech/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#05767075756a777145616066606b71776a2b7160666d) with the information currently submitted through the respective APIs. Our team will assist you in updating the details in our database.


Please note that the Turnaround Time (TAT) for such requests will be 2 working days.
